brief:
Palestinian citizens of Israel have launched daily protests against a settler outpost established in a Palestinian-majority town in the Galilee region, according to Middle East Eye. The outpost was built by settlers from the occupied West Bank, marking an expansion of settlement activity into areas within Israel's 1948 borders where Palestinian citizens maintain communities.

The mobilisation reflects growing tensions over settler expansion beyond the occupied territories and into mixed Palestinian-Israeli towns. The protests constitute a direct challenge to what demonstrators view as encroachment on their communities and land rights.
